subject: Hospitality
title: The Event Planner's Role
description: A quick win: understand The Event Planner's Role.

hook.text: Event planners are project managers, designers, negotiators, and crisis handlers—all simultaneously.

buildup.text: A planner coordinates venues, catering, AV, décor, transportation, registration, speakers, entertainment, and security.

discovery.text: The CMP (Certified Meeting Professional) credential requires 3+ years of experience and a comprehensive exam.

twist.text: Most event planners work 50–60 hour weeks during event season and face burnout rates above 30%.

climax.text: Great event planners are invisible: when everything runs perfectly, nobody notices them.

punchline.text: A thousand details, zero margin for error. Great planners are invisible.

quiz.question: What is the CMP credential?
options: Certified Meeting Professional—requiring 3+ years experience and a comprehensive exam
